description: A Gene–Symptom association from Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) phenotype-to-genes annotations. The association connects a gene to a phenotype concept represented as a Symptom.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Sources supporting the Gene–Symptom association; HPO supplies this contribution.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Timestamp of association creation or a change in source support.

source_contributions.scope: Phenotype-to-genes annotations whose NCBI Gene identifier and HPO phenotype are represented by existing Gene and HPO-enriched Symptom nodes. Unresolved genes or phenotypes are excluded. A Gene–Symptom association does not require a corresponding Disease association.
source_contributions.description: The annotations derive from HPO disease–phenotype and disease–gene annotations. Different source disorders can support the same phenotype–gene association. Each Gene–Symptom pair is represented once, regardless of repeated source annotations. HPO supplies no additional evidence metadata on these associations.
